tours.title: Serengeti Migration
tours.summary: Seven days on the short-grass plains, following the herds from a mobile camp that moves with the season.
tours.fieldNote: The diary entry for this route is usually written at dawn, when the wildebeest are still just a dark line on the horizon.

itinerary.title: Arusha to the Ndutu plains
itinerary.body: Meet your guide, fly to the southern Serengeti, and reach camp while the light is still long.

itinerary.title: Calving grounds
itinerary.body: A full day on the plains. The vehicle stays with one herd rather than chasing a checklist of species.

itinerary.title: Woodland and water
itinerary.body: Morning among acacia, afternoon at a soda lake where flamingo and jackal share the shore.

itinerary.title: Walk with the camp naturalist
itinerary.body: A slow foot safari near camp, then a long picnic under a shade tree you choose yourselves.

itinerary.title: North with the grass
itinerary.body: The camp shifts toward the central Serengeti. Game drive on the way, no rushed transit lunch.

itinerary.title: Kopjes at last light
itinerary.body: Lion country among the granite kopjes. Sundowners are poured where the rock holds the heat.

itinerary.title: One more morning, then out
itinerary.body: A final drive at first light and a flight back to Arusha before noon.

inclusions: Park fees and flying in and out of the Serengeti
Mobile camp, all meals, and drinking water

tours.title: Ngorongoro & Tarangire
tours.summary: Five days between baobab country and the crater floor. A shorter route for a first safari that still feels unhurried.
tours.fieldNote: People write about the elephants in Tarangire and then, the next evening, about how quiet the crater is after the rim.

itinerary.title: Into Tarangire
itinerary.body: Drive from Arusha into the baobabs. Elephants are usually at the river by late afternoon.

itinerary.title: A full day in the park
itinerary.body: Dawn drive, a long lunch back at camp, and a second loop only if you want it.

itinerary.title: The crater rim
itinerary.body: Travel to a lodge on the Ngorongoro rim. The afternoon is for the view, not another road.

itinerary.title: Down onto the floor
itinerary.body: A day inside the crater: black rhino country, soda lake, and a picnic the guides know by heart.

itinerary.title: Back to Arusha
itinerary.body: A slow morning on the rim and a return to town after lunch.

inclusions: Lodge and camp stays, meals, and water

diary.title: A dark line at dawn
paragraphs: The herd was not a sighting. It was a change in the colour of the ground, a kilometre out, still deciding whether to move.
We switched the engine off. The guide passed the binoculars without talking. In the book that night I wrote only the time, and the fact that the grass was wet enough to darken our boots.
That is the Serengeti page. The animals come into it later, once you have sat still.

diary.title: After the rim
paragraphs: Tarangire had been all bark and dust and elephants shouldering through it. The crater the next day was a bowl of short green, and much quieter than its reputation.
A black rhino stayed on the far side of a soda flat for the whole picnic. Nobody asked to drive closer. The note in the margin is just the distance, guessed, and then crossed out.
Five days is enough if the days are not filled for you.
